Q: Flet v0.83.0 Websocket session time out is really fast A:

Probable Workaround: looks like the tunnel approach works.
from AWS Ec2 machine to local Mac, with the following options added.
ssh -Y -N -L 8005:127.0.0.1:8005 -o ServerAliveInterval=30 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3 ec2-user@comp1
But if there is a nginx server through which access is done, with a DNS name,
then that probably needs to be configured properly, other wise
when the old Flet session is dropped and a new session is created, all the pages of the Flet App are
renewed with no data.

Q: Removing skype for business using powershell A:

Any msi install can be uninstalled like this (powershell 5.1):

uninstall-package 'Microsoft Skype for Business MUI (English) 2016'

Or

get-package '*skype for business*' | uninstall-package
